ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-grey) across >95% of the visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels are isolated to localized scarring and calcified accretions at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity dark region spanning the main body of both lobes. High-contrast white annular clusters (rings) and linear tracks are scattered distally. Dense white pixel clusters are localized on the extreme outer tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with a clearly defined vertex and symmetrical slopes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous boundary exhibiting irregular micro-serrations; topography displays moderate amplitude peaks and valleys, increasing in frequency toward the distal lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lobed convex curve along the trailing edge, exhibiting an upward sweep terminating in tapered, pointed distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast white annular rings (approximately 12-15 distinct units) distributed across both lobes, with higher concentration on the left (viewer's left) distal quadrant.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) of varying lengths, primarily oriented horizontally or diagonally across the mid-to-outer fluke surfaces.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified barnacle colonization on both distal fluke tips; multiple high-contrast circular parasitic scars and extensive linear rake marks across the dark pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy, high-intensity white encrustations forming irregular massed textures on the terminal edges of both fluke lobes.
